project: Metal Gear 1987 Remaster / Operation Intrude N313 / 1995 Outer Heaven

priority: 1987 MSX2 original game, documented script, official Konami manual
Source-backed walkthrough and captured complete MSX2 playthrough
Later revised MSX2 translations where clearly identified as revised text
Connect2Media/J2ME edition only after direct verification
Later-series canon as consistency check, never an excuse to overwrite 1987 dialogue
source_policy.translation_rule: Preserve the original order, functions, character knowledge, surprises and causal consequences. Any new 3D scene, crawl space, civilian activity, guard behaviour or voice line must be explicitly labeled REMAKE_INTERPRETATION; not claimed verbatim original.

source_classes.MSX_VERIFIED: Source-backed 1987 game/manual script or independently corroborated walkthrough
source_classes.REVISED: Revised official localization, not the 1987 on-screen wording
source_classes.INTERPRETATION: New 3D physical/dramatic construction preserving the event's purpose
source_classes.UNVERIFIED: Not supported yet by an inspected authoritative source

Break out of prison, evade security and locate confiscated weapons and equipment

sequence: Shoot Gunner / revised Shotmaker prison encounter with a wide triple volley
Recovery of confiscated inventory and inspection/discard of planted transmitter
chronology.current: Source encounter and pickups exist but several historically plausible alternatives and nonmandatory defeat require edition-verified tests. Do not label a changed gate canon.

Find suspicious wall, use plastic explosive to open continuation
Later Building 1 encounters include Machinegun Kid and acquisition of a parachute

weapon_rules.noncanonical_debug_policy: Stun pistol is a sandbox/testing affordance, NOT acquired in 1987 campaign. For a wired-electrode conducted-energy device, do not emit spent brass cartridge casings each press; a replaceable dart cartridge is not a firearm shell. Do not apply handgun slide/recoil/slide-lock animation to it.
weapon_rules.original_remote_missile: Directional remote guidance pauses Snake's normal locomotion while guiding, not an MGS1/Nikita-era weapon skin.
weapon_rules.smg_reference: Original dialogue names an Ingram MAC-11; exact 3D mesh and animation remain art-provenance work.
weapon_rules.quality_gate: No weapon can be marked implemented merely because an OBJ or inventory ID exists; it needs authorized mesh, sockets, animations, gameplay, sound, reload/save and actually tested editor build.

adaptations.intent: Provide an optional player-understandable low route under intact service infrastructure during the post-Card-3 dog challenge
adaptations.never_override: Dog encounter and later explosive wall remain narrative beats; player need not crawl and should not be forced into a new story flag.

adaptations.intent: Translate 2D dog threats into grounded patrol/LOS/bark/attack recovery with tangible escape routes
adaptations.never_override: Dogs are not telepathic human guards; they alert from the dog's own world position only.

adaptations.intent: Separate an original riot-gun body and pump for readable shoulder-to-weapon physical timing
adaptations.never_override: Specific firearm make, 1987 exact shell mechanics, and Shotmaker's inner motives are unverified.

red_lines: Do not introduce a 2005 Codec or give 1995 Snake later-series technology.
Do not depict imprisoned Fox as a cyborg ninja.
Do not introduce invented speaking NPCs as if they originated in the 1987 script.
Do not add a second Metal Gear or reorder Machinegun Kid/Gray Fox/Shotmaker for spectacle.
Do not equate text-based source gate with a finished animation, imported rig, voice session or playable mission.
Do not permit early Card 3 bypass or unearned explosives/missiles/SMG through testing inventory defaults.
honest_status: Source and code edits are uncompiled and unplaytested in UE5.7. Direct J2ME source-edition geometry, exact names and layouts still need verification.
